line: Pilar Ochoa, I run the programs at the hall. Two things you should know: the coffee is free, and if you stand still too long I give you a job.
Pilar Ochoa, from the parish hall on Grand. I'm here with Doña Carmen. Her doctor talks fast and she nods. I'm the one who says 'again, slower.'
choice3: I'd rather not chat right now.

line: Tuesday nights we do citizenship prep with the library. Ruth Hale sends the books, I send the people. Last month eleven passed. One cried on the bus home.
Because the library is everybody's. People come to the hall because it feels like home. Then I walk them across Grand so the library feels like home too. That's the job.
choice2: That's a good way to put it.

line: Slowly. Don Aurelio says I'm giving our people away. Ray says I'm too slow. I say both of them should come Tuesday and read the civics questions out loud.
The roof raffle: first prize is a set of tires. Four hundred tickets sold. I have no idea who donated the tires and I'm afraid to ask.
Doña Carmen again. Dr. Haddad's front desk knows me by name now. Last week the receptionist saved us the two chairs by the window.
You'd be good at the Tuesday class. Not teaching. Just sitting with someone who's nervous and saying 'take your time.' That's half of it.
choice2: I'm not sure I'm the right person.

line: Thursday, Ruth and I are doing a night at the library: library cards, know-your-rights, pan dulce from Sra. Reyes's sister. I need people who know both doors. Come?
Four people didn't come to class Tuesday. One texted: 'Better not to be on a list.' I keep the sign-in sheet in my purse now. I don't know if that's smart or silly.
The city wants to fund the Tuesday class. A real teacher. Don Aurelio says city money comes with a leash. I say I'll take the leash if it comes with chairs.
You're here so much I count you in the coffee. Good. Now come with me Tuesday to the library. Bring the hall with you.
Ruth tells me you're at the library every week. Good. Next time, come back across Grand and tell us what's going on over there.
Pilar is busy with a clipboard. "Hi."
choice1: Pilar, I'm sorry about last time.

line: Not now, the coffee urn is making the noise again. The noise means trouble.
